item.title: School Construction Authority — Special Materials: NOTICE OF FILING - 108-14 ASTORIA BOULEVARD, QUEENS
item.description:
Outcome: Special Materials
NOTICE OF FILING Pursuant to §1731 of the New York Public Authorities Law, notice has been filed for the proposed site selection of all or portions of Block 1703, Lot(s) 86, 87, 93, 94, 97-99 and any other nearby sites for the construction of a new school facility. The NYC Department of Education (DOE) is proposing a facility designed for an approximately 676-seat high school in Queens. The proposed site is located at 108-14 Astoria Boulevard on the south side of Astoria Boulevard between 108 th Street and 110 th Street in the East Elmhurst neighborhood of Queens. item.title: Environmental Protection — Procurement: 82627B0020-BEDC-CAT-475 High Level Outlet Install Gilboa Dam and Crest Gate Removal
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
This Competitive Sealed Bid ( RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York City s online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82627B0020 into the Keywords search field. If you need assistance submitting a response, please contact MOCS Service Desk: mocssupport.atla

item.title: Teachers' Retirement System — Public Hearings and Meetings: Teachers Retirement System of the City of New York Monthly Board Meeting
item.description:
Outcome: Public Hearings and Meetings
Please be advised that the next Board Meeting of the Teachers Retirement System of the City of New York (TRS) has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 3:30 p.m. The meeting will be held at the Teachers Retirement System, 55 Water Street, 16 th Floor, Boardroom, New York, NY 10041. The meeting is open to the public. However, portions of the meeting, where permitted by law, may be held in executive session. The remote Zoom meeting link, meeting ID, and phone number will be available approximately one hour before the start of the meeting at: https://www.trsnyc.org/memberportal/Abo
